title: Q-ULTRA-spec_quality-1: Work items an agent cannot misread out of bounds: rewrite the open items that miss a part so they pass specgate, from their own source code
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** essential variable `spec_quality` out of bounds (reading 0.258; limits 0.9 to None)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** closed

ULTRASTABILITY-1 second-order step: rewrite the open items that miss a part so they pass specgate, from their own source code. unlearn.dev lesson: a vague item gets a plausible wrong fix. An item passes foundation/specgate.py only with all four parts.

**Prediction:** spec.quality >= 0.9 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** changing the bounds of `spec_quality` or any other essential variable; a step is judged by the reading, never by relaxing the limit.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `spec_quality` inside its bounds.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T21:22:56Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-26T00:58:08Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: workers-ai-glm: HTTPError: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized | github-models-gpt: RuntimeError: non-JSON re. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
